about: Where a pepper goes in a produced password (ADR 0174), checked against Python's own slicing. For each expression, `cuts[n]` is [head, tail]: how many characters (code points) of an n-character password come before and after the pepper. Generated by scripts/test/pepper-position-reference.py from Python's slice semantics, independent of the TypeScript and Rust readers; read by packages/vault-core and crates/sealed-store. Never regenerate to make a test pass.
